notes: Two ح-branches meet at «قالا حدثنا ابن عون» (dual, rule 3): the tail is written once for both.

Abu Qilaba narrates his own presence; Anbasa speaks inside that story and quotes Anas (هكذا حدثنا أنس بن مالك), so Anbasa and Anas are read as the last links (owner ruling 5, rule 6). This is the reading to check if contested.
The second «قال أبو قلابة» and «قال عنبسة سبحان الله» are dialogue inside the story, not links.
